summary: Full acceptance run for Wave-8 (hero trust strip, monthly tip goal, docs mobile nav, product editor live preview). ALL four features PASS end-to-end; safe-mode preserved (goal restored to empty at end). 1) HERO TRUST STRIP — /home hero-trust-strip renders with 4 pills exactly as specced: hero-trust-noncustodial ('Non-custodial' → /about#about-legitimacy), hero-trust-coins ('15 coins' → /fees), hero-trust-fees ('Fees from 0.5%' → /fees), hero-trust-since ('Since 2024' → /about). Clicking hero-trust-noncustodial navigates to /about#about-legitimacy and the about-legitimacy anchor is present. proof-strip below (proof-uptime, proof-settle, proof-month, proof-countries) still renders. Mobile 390x844: strip visible, 4 pills wrap onto 2 centered rows (row1 noncustodial+coins, row2 fees+since). 2) MONTHLY TIP GOAL — Backend GET /api/pay/creator/devhub → data.support_widget.monthly_goal=null and month_raised=null when goal is off. /storefront (auth) shows number input data-testid=support-widget-monthly-goal, empty by default, with label 'Monthly tip goal (optional — leave empty to hide the bar)' and hint 'Shows "$X of $Y this month" on your page. Counts confirmed tips and resets on the 1st.' Typing 500 → live preview data-testid=preview-tip-goal shows '$210 of $500 this month · 42%'. Save → 'Creator page saved' toast fires; GET returns monthly_goal=500, month_raised=0 (number ≥ 0). /devhub public: tip-goal-bar rendered, tip-goal-label='$0.00 of $500.00 this month', tip-goal-pct='0%', tip-goal-footer='Resets in 16 days' (D=16, between 1..31); progressbar role has aria-valuenow=0, aria-valuemin=0, aria-valuemax=100. Min-snap works: typing 5 and blurring snaps to 10. Cleared field back to empty and saved → GET monthly_goal=null, month_raised=null and /devhub no longer renders tip-goal-bar. 3) DOCS MOBILE NAV — /documentation @390x844: docs-mobile-nav sticky, docs-mobile-current shows 'Overview' initially. docs-mobile-sections-btn opens docs-mobile-sheet with docs-mobile-search at top. All 18 section buttons docs-sheet-section- present for overview, getting-started, try-it, authentication, customers, payments, embed, elements, wallets, transactions, events, currencies, wallet-management, payment-statuses, buy-button, webhooks, rate-limits, errors. Active section button has aria-current='true'. Clicking docs-sheet-section-webhooks closes sheet, page scrolls to #webhooks, docs-mobile-current updates to 'Webhooks' (after ~1s IntersectionObserver debounce). docs-pager-webhooks visible with prev='Buy Button' and next='Rate Limits'; clicking Next updates docs-mobile-current to 'Rate Limits'. First-section pager docs-pager-overview has no prev button (next only); last-section pager docs-pager-errors has no next (prev only). Search flow: fill docs-mobile-search 'Web' → click Webhooks result → sheet closes and page scrolls to Webhooks. Desktop 1920x800: docs-mobile-nav and docs-pager-* are all not visible. 4) PRODUCT EDITOR LIVE PREVIEW — /pay-links/products/new (desktop 1920): product-editor-layout renders, product-preview-desktop and product-live-preview visible (sticky on right); initial values product-live-preview-title='Your product title', -price='$0.00', -type='Digital', -draft='Draft'. Typing title → title updates live; price 49.5 → '$49.50'; subtitle 'Limited run' → subtitle appears; multi-paragraph description → product-live-preview-desc reflects content. Switching currency to EUR via MUI select → price becomes '€0.00' (currency symbol changes). product-preview-toggle hidden at desktop width. Mobile 390: product-preview-desktop hidden, product-preview-toggle visible; clicking expands product-live-preview reflecting typed title; clicking again collapses (toggle label switches to 'Hide preview' when open). Existing product 'Talk to a Developer' /pay-links/products/9/edit: preview shows real title 'Talk to a Developer', price '$100.00', product-live-preview-cover contains a real (DO Spaces CDN URL), and NO Draft badge (product is live). No save/publish actions performed (SAFE MODE). REGRESSION: /devhub (bar hidden after clear), /about, /fees, /create-pay-link (auth) — 0 console errors. Sidebar still reads 'Payout addresses' (verified). /devhub/shop returned a transient 502 for one resource fetch (dev server memory pressure as flagged) — non-blocking, page renders. Final state on prod DB: monthly_goal restored to NULL on tbl_company for company_id=1 (only permitted write).
critical_code_review_comments: MUI Select for currency (Value/Currency row on /pay-links/products/new) is intermittently intercepted by the sticky data-testid=main-page-header at some scroll offsets — playwright needed force=True + scroll offset. Consider bumping the sticky header z-index only when a modal is open, or ensuring MUI overlay portal z-index sits above the header (currently sticky header intercepts the outlined-select's click bounding box after content shifts). Real users can still click, but keyboard/screen-reader focus flow can trip the same overlap.
seed_data_creation: None permanent. Temporarily set support_widget_monthly_goal=500 on tbl_company for company_id=1 via /storefront Save, then cleared back to NULL. Verified via GET /api/pay/creator/devhub before/after.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Product editor uses testids product-title-input / product-subtitle-input / product-price-input / (textarea) for edits — no need for MUI clicks except currency. Currency select is a MUI combobox with aria-labelledby=ccy-label (data-value=EUR/USD/... on <li>). Docs page IntersectionObserver takes ~1s to update docs-mobile-current after scroll — wait 1.2–1.5s before asserting. /devhub tip-goal-bar month_raised on a fresh goal will read $0.00 until confirmed tips arrive; 'Resets in D days' D is computed against calendar-month end (16 as of test date). API auth token is in localStorage['token']; pass as `Authorization: Bearer <t>` for /api/products. Native <details> still used for pay-link advanced options (unchanged).
